notes: Linked from https://www.pizzaexpress.com/allergens-and-nutritionals (page needs fetch_protected; WebFetch 403s). PDF has 19 columns: cols 1-9 PER PORTION, cols 10-18 PER 100g. The generic parser correctly binds kcal=col1 and protein=col8, i.e. PER PORTION - but it stamps serving_desc='per 100g' because the page text contains 'PER 100g'; that flag is wrong, the numbers are per portion. Verified against raw table: Hot Honey Dough Balls 415 kcal / 9.8g protein per portion. Three sibling nutritionals PDFs exist (4248f3d3..=53 items, 43d31e9d..=292 items, 79d486ac..=33 items) for other regions/menus. ADAPTER: scripts/scrapers/chains/pizza_express.py reads the per-portion columns directly and labels serving_desc 'per serving', correcting the generic parser's misleading 'per 100g' stamp.
